descriptionHtml: The seminar will be focused on the field of solar energy and supercapacitors, new trends in supercapacitors, how to apply for higher studies in Australia or New Zealand, and current Ph.D. opportunities at the University of Auckland. The resource person is well experienced in the field of Electronics and the talk will be informative and useful for the undergraduate students to make their decisions on higher studies.
venue: DEEE Seminar Room, Faculty of Engineering
